title: Naturally Smoked Argentinian Beef Skewers
description: Roasted, juicy, indulgent Argentinian dish featuring vinegar, smoke, and satvik-friendly ingredients, this recipe is perfect for a special occasion
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, whisk together apple cider vinegar, olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper
Add the beef strips to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes
Thread the marinated beef strips onto skewers
Place the skewers on the grill and cook for 10 minutes per side
Add wood chips to the grill to infuse a smoky flavor
Cook for an additional 5 minutes or until the beef reaches an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving
